topic: The meeting was called off at the last minute
title: The meeting was called off at the last minute
pt: Foco da aula: phrasal verbs no passivo: called off, put off, carried out

lines.en: Emeka, did you see the email? The meeting was called off at the last minute, and nobody told the team until noon.
lines.pt: Emeka, você viu o e-mail? A reunião foi cancelada de última hora, e ninguém avisou a equipe até o meio-dia.

lines.en: I did. They said it was called off because of the snow, and the new date will be worked out next week.
lines.pt: Vi. Disseram que foi cancelada por causa da neve, e a nova data será definida na semana que vem.

lines.en: That is the third time this month. The budget review was put off twice already, and the client is losing patience.
lines.pt: É a terceira vez este mês. A revisão do orçamento já foi adiada duas vezes, e o cliente está perdendo a paciência.

lines.en: I understand, but the roads were closed this morning. Even the training session downtown was cancelled, and two people were turned away.
lines.pt: Entendo, mas as ruas estavam fechadas esta manhã. Até o treinamento no centro foi cancelado, e duas pessoas foram mandadas de volta.

lines.en: Fair enough. Meanwhile, the safety checks were carried out yesterday, and the building was found to be in good condition.
lines.pt: Justo. Enquanto isso, as verificações de segurança foram feitas ontem, e o prédio foi considerado em boas condições.

lines.en: Good. Our new software is being set up this week too, so the whole system will be tested on Friday.
lines.pt: Bom. Nosso novo software também está sendo instalado esta semana, então o sistema todo será testado na sexta.

lines.en: I hope nothing else is put off. My report was handed in on time, and I would hate to wait for a decision.
lines.pt: Espero que nada mais seja adiado. Meu relatório foi entregue no prazo, e eu odiaria esperar por uma decisão.

lines.en: Do not worry. The manager said that the results would be looked at as soon as the roads were cleared.
lines.pt: Não se preocupe. A gerente disse que os resultados seriam analisados assim que as ruas fossem liberadas.

lines.en: I wish the news had been announced before. I rearranged my whole morning, and a call with a supplier was pushed back.
lines.pt: Queria que a notícia tivesse sido anunciada antes. Reorganizei minha manhã inteira, e uma ligação com um fornecedor foi adiada.

lines.en: Same here. Next time, let us ask that all changes be sent out by email at least the evening before.
lines.pt: Comigo também. Da próxima vez, vamos pedir que todas as mudanças sejam enviadas por e-mail pelo menos na noite anterior.

lines.en: Agreed. I will write it up and send it to the manager, and we will see whether it gets taken seriously.
lines.pt: Combinado. Vou redigir e enviar à gerente, e veremos se será levado a sério.

facts.label: cancelado
facts.sub: Called off é o passivo de call off. The meeting was called off significa que alguém cancelou a reunião. Use quando o agente não importa.

facts.label: adiado
facts.sub: Put off no passivo quer dizer que algo foi adiado: The review was put off twice. Depois do particípio, a partícula vem junto.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: The meeting was called off is passive.
We say The meeting was off called.
items.why: The particle stays after the participle.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: The meeting was called off is passive. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say The meeting was off called. → Falso (The particle stays after the participle.)
Put off means delay. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: The meeting was called off at the last minute · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a snowy Wednesday in Denver. Fay arrives at the office late. The roads are slippery. Bia is at her desk. They talk about the news.

“Bia, did you see the email? The meeting was called off at the last minute, and nobody told the team until noon.” says Fay. “I did. They said it was called off because of the snow, and the new date will be worked out next week.” says Bia. “That is the third time this month. The budget review was put off twice already, and the client is losing patience.” says Fay.
